open_points.subject: M25 StandingGrant vs State 0 grant/revoke action
open_points.text: State 0: "grant or revoke a standing approval for a node of a flow's active version"; M25: "The owner's standing approval for one node of one flow version"
open_points.question: Must grant/revoke be refused unless the referenced flow version is currently active for its flow?
options: Grant/revoke allowed only on the flow's current active version
Grant/revoke allowed on any proven version (active or inactive)
open_points.default_guess: Allow only the active version, per State 0 action wording.

open_points.subject: EffectAttempt (M26) readability and product surface
open_points.text: M26: "Read by the run's recovery after restart and by the owner resolving an unknown outcome."
open_points.question: Through which product action can owner/agent read EffectAttempt facts (especially idempotency_key), if at all?
options: Do not expose EffectAttempt on the product surface
open_points.default_guess: Expose it via read trace so idempotency behavior is observable.

open_points.subject: Inspect scope for approvals/grants
open_points.text: State 0 inspect action: "inspect functions, flows, runs, bindings"; M24 says "agents may read approvals" and M25/M26 are durable authority records
open_points.question: Is inspect intentionally limited to those four subjects, or does it also include approvals/grants (and possibly effect attempts)?
options: Inspect is limited strictly to functions/flows/runs/bindings
Inspect includes approvals and grants as additional subjects
Inspect includes approvals, grants, and effect attempts
open_points.default_guess: Include approvals and grants in inspect; keep effect attempts under trace.

open_points.subject: M22 SpooledFile disclosure_class derivation
open_points.text: M22 candidate fields include "disclosure_class" but no rule defines how it is assigned
open_points.question: What rule sets a spooled file's disclosure_class when produced by function or operation nodes?
options: Function output file gets highest class received by that execution; operation output file gets binding output class
Always take class from producing port declaration
Always inherit class from originating run input when traceable
open_points.default_guess: Use the same derivation as other outputs: function by highest received class, operation by binding-declared output class.
